name: daylight-shelter-facade
description: SHELTER-CATEGORY: an HDB household shelter is never advised to add a window, even when it sits ON the facade. Loads tpl-hdb-4room, whose shelter is authored against an external wall (asserted in daylight.test.ts, so this fixture cannot go inert) and asserts the Daylight panel renders it as a neutral N/A while a genuinely fixable room still reads as a failure. Pro-tier panel; Simple arm covered by daylight-simple.json.

steps.name: dismiss-overlays
steps.eval: try { localStorage.setItem('hdb_onboarded','1') } catch {}; const s = window.__store.getState(); s.endTour?.(); s.setOnboardingOpen?.(false); s.dismissLocationPrompt?.()

steps.name: scroll-to-shelter
steps.eval: (()=>{const t=[...document.querySelectorAll('#daylightPanel .ci-title')].find(e=>e.textContent.includes('Household Shelter')); if(!t) throw new Error('no Household Shelter row'); t.closest('.clr-item').scrollIntoView({block:'center'}); return 'ok'})()

steps.name: assert-shelter-na
steps.eval: (()=>{const t=[...document.querySelectorAll('#daylightPanel .ci-title')].find(e=>e.textContent.includes('Household Shelter')); const row=t.closest('.clr-item'); if(row.classList.contains('err')) throw new Error('shelter still styled as an error'); const b=row.querySelector('.badge'); if(b.textContent.trim()!=='N/A') throw new Error('shelter badge is '+b.textContent); return 'ok'})()

steps.name: assert-a-real-failure-survives
steps.eval: (()=>{const rows=[...document.querySelectorAll('#daylightPanel .clr-item')]; const errs=rows.filter(r=>r.classList.contains('err')).map(r=>r.querySelector('.ci-title').textContent.trim()); if(errs.length===0) throw new Error('every room was suppressed - over-suppression'); return errs.join(', ')})()
